page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r5.8xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server built on the KVM hypervisor. The hardware configuration features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB per vCPU allocation designed specifically for memory-demanding infrastructure.

This server type does not feature bundled local storage, requiring persistent data to be retained on external cloud block storage. It contains zero dedicated GPU accelerators and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Network connectivity is supported by a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth profile, allowing steady throughput for node-to-node communication and data synchronization across cloud clusters.

The 1:8 compute-to-memory ratio provides resource density that benefits memory-bound applications without necessitating excess compute core allocation. The absence of local disk drives requires consideration of network storage latency for write-intensive pipelines. The configuration provides a stable execution environment for distributed in-memory databases, enterprise caching solutions, real-time stream processing, and big data analytics.
